facts.note: Transcript gives the same watch (Félix's silver watch), the same moment (temple strikes nine), and the same reading (twenty minutes to nine), and the uncle's scene in front of everyone.
Félix goes to the library and stays alone; when the temple strikes ten, his watch shows twenty to ten.
At eighteen past ten by his watch, a thump right above him in the atelier, then the uncle's repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
At a quarter past ten by his watch someone went quickly up past the library door; at twenty-one past ten someone came quickly down. He did not see who and the door was shut.
The aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.

The arrival at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch and the sitting together until the temple struck eleven are present, but the visitor is never named as Bastien Girard. The sentence says only 'He', which in context reads as the uncle ('He said he wanted a word', 'He was not in a good humour'). The person differs from the fact sheet.
